shorts.title: GTA 6: Where Is GTA Online?
shorts.description:
Take-Two says GTA 6 launches as a single-player game, and no date has been announced for a new online mode. The current GTA Online keeps running.
Story first or online first? #gta6 #gtavi #shorts

shorts.title: GTA 6 Ultimate Edition: Is It Worth $100?
shorts.description:
GTA 6 Ultimate is $99.99 vs $79.99 for Standard. It adds exclusive cars and weapons, plus extra in-world shops like a salon and a clothing store.
Worth it or not? #gta6 #gtavi #shorts
